findings.summary: No wall-time signal, so the ~80-minute prompt-budget trap may show no signal firing
findings.evidence: The signals the plan lists are retries, plan growth, cost (dollars) against forecast p90, same-criterion rejection, and 3 attempts or $5. The only figure for the prompt-budget trap is about 80 minutes of time lost; no dollar amount or retry count is supplied for it. Criterion 3 requires the replay to show which signals fire on it. Fix: Add a signal for wall time against the forecast p90 (labeled 'estimate, to be tuned'). The replay should then show that signal firing on the prompt-budget trap. If nothing would fire, say so plainly and treat it as a gap in the design.
findings.location: Plan decision 5 / thrash signals; Criterion 3 demonstration (prompt-budget trap replay)

findings.summary: docs/decisions.md has no convention for marking a decision as proposed
findings.evidence: D126 (docs/decisions.md:3138-3171) has the fields Case, Decision, Timings, Alternatives, Tradeoff, Reversal cost and Provenance, but no status field. Searching the file for 'status' or 'proposed' finds no decision-status marker. Fix: Choose one visible marker and use it in both D127 and the CHANGELOG line. For example, add '(proposed)' to the D127 heading and put a '**Status:** proposed, not built' line first in the entry. Keep the other fields in D126's layout.

findings.summary: Cite the BRIEF.md pantheon rows by their exact lines
findings.evidence: The Artemis, Hestia and Demeter rows are at BRIEF.md lines 603, 604 and 607. The relay note is at line 1067. The plan says 'lines 603-607', which also takes in rows that do not apply. Fix: In the Mapping section, cite lines 603, 604, 607 and 1067 individually.

summary: The plan matches the request and the accepted reading: one design document, D127 after D126, and a CHANGELOG line, with no code or configuration changes. Everything it names exists. BRIEF.md has the Artemis (line 603), Hestia (604) and Demeter (607) rows and the relay note at line 1067. D126 is the last decision in docs/decisions.md and records the speedup jobs and the 651 s to 392 s figure. job-planning.md section 9 is 'Measuring it, and when to keep it'. The steward is described in roles-and-ladder.md. I searched xtask/tests and found no check on decision numbering or a docs inventory. Each figure is labeled as supplied by the request, taken from a repository source, or an estimate, as the reading requires. The rules-versus-model split, the powers (Sri decides drops), and the protections for learnings work (quota, proceed when in doubt, appeal) cover criteria 4 and 5. The demonstrations are reads of the document, which suits a docs-only job. The criterion 3 demonstration includes a sound 'fails without' check: the same-criterion signal must fire at the second speedup rejection. Three small findings: add a wall-time signal so the prompt-budget trap replay has something to fire, pick an explicit 'proposed' marker because the decisions file has none, and cite the BRIEF.md lines exactly. The work fits one producer run.
